# AIWMC Quantis

> Test a business decision before you fund it. Quantis turns a decision (a hire, a new location, a price change, a new business) into explicit assumptions and deterministic cash, break-even and payback math, with base, downside and upside scenarios. Built by AIWMC LLC.

Financial figures are calculated by a deterministic engine before any AI writes narration. Each report includes a 1,000-iteration monthly profit range (P10/P50/P90) that varies the report's own revenue and costs; it is a range of modeled months, not a prediction. Benchmark defaults come from a 97,500-cell modeled coverage grid (modeled cells, not observed companies) and are labeled so users can replace them with their own numbers. Quantis does not guarantee outcomes.

## Plans and offers

- Free ($0): 5 complete Decision Runs per month.
- Plus ($17/month or $168/year): unlimited analyses, PDF export, scenarios and decision tools.
- Pro ($49/month or $492/year): everything in Plus, with investor-ready outputs.
- [Founder Decision Review](/decision-review) ($349, one-time): one active founder decision; 30-minute intake, fact/assumption/unknown register, base/downside/upside scenarios, cash/break-even/payback reconciliation, Decision Memo, live review and one revision.
- [Consultant Founding Pilot](/decision-review) ($499, one-time): two client cases within 30 days, for consultants, fractional CFOs and advisors.
